sessions.scope: Private portfolio schemas, three disclosure modes, and four field classes
Repository-external private workspaces, offline execution, redaction, sanitization, sensitive-file checks, and privacy-safe diagnostics
Shared period, XBRL, unit, currency, share-count, fiscal-calendar, denominator, and missing-tag controls
Eleven shared notes, sources, conflict, and subsequent-event controls
CROX, AZO, ODFL, ITT live acceptance, safe outcomes, Hard Stop rendering, and anti-hardcoding

checks: S01 retains the annotated Friday V1 tag, environment manifest, regeneration command, hashes, and CROX/AZO frozen artifacts.
S02 Gate 4 consumes only the shared Gate 3 contract and returns GATE_4_BLOCKED_STALE_GATE_3 for stale inputs without rebuilding issuer analysis.
S03 contains policy, exposure, holdings, opportunity, and approval schemas; supports exposure-only, aggregated portfolio, and full holdings; and enforces all four field classes.

S04 keeps private inputs and outputs outside Git worktrees, runs private calculation paths offline, sanitizes diagnostics and PDF metadata, scans sensitive files, and never fills missing inputs with defaults.
S05 preserves the deterministic ODFL first run and its failures, warnings, diagnostic, command, runtime, and SHA256 registry.
S06 owns period and XBRL analytical rules in the shared Data and Evidence Layer; downstream code delegates to those selectors.
S07 owns eleven first-class note/event modules and blocks silent material source conflicts or post-period mixing.
S08 owns four-company live acceptance and confirms safe failure and anti-overfitting behavior.

warnings: Live-company results are dated and must be regenerated after new filings or material events.
Acceptance of MISSING or WARNING means the conclusion was constrained correctly; it does not validate unavailable evidence.
The shared issuer core does not yet claim support for financial institutions or every specialized capital structure.
exact_next_starting_point: Await explicit user approval before merging or pushing the completed Phase A and Phase B branch to main.
